title: D CORE LC-LC 2.0mm 5M Single-Mode Duplex Fiber Patch Cord

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE LC-LC 2.0mm 5M Single-Mode Duplex Fiber Patch Cord is a high-quality optical cable designed for long-distance, high-speed data transmission. Built with OS2 9/125µm single-mode fiber, premium LC/UPC duplex connectors, and a durable 2.0mm LSZH jacket, this 5-meter patch cord delivers excellent performance for FTTH networks, ISP backbones, data centers, OLT-to-ONU connections, and enterprise optical systems.

Its extended 5-meter length provides flexible installation for larger rack layouts and telecom rooms.


Key Features


  • LC to LC Duplex (UPC) Connectors for stable and precise optical transmission
  • OS2 Single-Mode Fiber (9/125 µm) ensures long-distance, low-loss performance
  • 5 Meter Length ideal for wider rack setups and extended device-to-device connections
  • 2.0mm LSZH Jacket ensures safer indoor cabling with low smoke & zero halogen
  • Low Insertion Loss (≤0.3 dB) provides consistent and reliable connectivity
  • High Return Loss (≥50 dB) reduces signal interference and reflection
  • Fully compatible with OLT, ONU, switches, routers, SFP/SFP+ modules, media converters
  • Flexible Duplex Design for easy routing and quick installation
